description: Unify AgentJob and WorkflowRun dispatch under owner-led ledgers and remove Runner work staging.

tasks.title: Make AgentJob its own dispatch ledger
tasks.description: Add durable AgentJob scheduling state and a queryable projection for assignment, readiness, running work, and immutable dispatch data. Migrate active AgentJob rows from persisted state, replace push retries with owner readiness timeout, and add atomic AgentJob claim and owner report validation.
acceptanceCriteria: An admitted AgentJob persists its runner assignment, ready time, work identity, and reconstructable dispatch without creating a Runner work record.
After grain activation or server restart, active AgentJob work is discoverable through the AgentJob projection and reconstructable from the AgentJob ledger.
A pending AgentJob past the configured readiness deadline fails as runner-unavailable without dispatch-attempt backoff or Runner acceptance state.
Server specs cover admission, activation recovery, atomic claim, stale report rejection, readiness timeout with fake time, and projection query cost independent of terminal history.
The server test suite for the affected Agent and persistence modules passes.
tasks.output: AgentJob scheduling state, indexed AgentJobs projection, data migration, and owner-led AgentJob grain behavior.
tasks.notes: Keep the projection an AgentJob-owned read model; owner commands remain the authority for claims and reports.

tasks.title: Unify poll delivery and claim scheduling
tasks.description: Extend DispatchService and Runner poll admission to assemble redelivery and new claims from WorkflowRun and AgentJob ledgers in one recovery-first order. Integrate AgentJob claims with the existing Runner lifecycle gate so both owners share capacity and dispatch construction failures retain recoverable owner state.
acceptanceCriteria: A runner poll returns ready AgentJob work without push assignment, and redelivers missing running work from either owner before claiming pending work.
Assigned pending work precedes unassigned work, and mixed WorkflowRun and AgentJob candidates are served by readiness time within each candidate layer.
No poll can claim work beyond the runner's combined configured slots; a capacity race leaves the AgentJob pending for a later poll.
A failed claim is skipped, ordinary dispatch rendering failures are retried by a later poll, and a retired action fails only the exact active owner work.
Server specs cover mixed-owner poll order, redelivery, capacity races, activation recovery, and deterministic dispatch rejection using fake time and in-memory stores.
tasks.output: Stateless mixed-owner poll assembly and shared-capacity claim path in DispatchService and Runner lifecycle handling.
tasks.notes: Do not introduce a queue, cursor, cache, or generic work aggregate.

tasks.title: Remove Runner work staging and relay paths
tasks.description: Switch AgentJob reports, active-work views, task-log authorization, and runner-loss closeout to owner-led paths. Remove Runner AgentJob work state, persistence, hydration, assignment/reconciliation APIs, report relay, and the obsolete RunnerWorks schema after the new path has no consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentJob reports reach the owning grain directly, and both accepted and stale responses acknowledge runner report retries.
Runner runtime state and AgentJob task-log authorization derive active work from AgentJob projection data rather than RunnerWorks.
Unregister and presence expiry report runner-lost to each running owner; AgentJob records a failed terminal result and a later report is stale.
No production path reads or writes Runner-held AgentJob work, and the RunnerWorks table, store, state types, relay, and legacy push/reconciliation tests are removed.
Server specs cover direct report acknowledgement, task-log authorization, runner-loss closeout, stale late reports, and absence of Runner work persistence; the affected server test suite passes.
tasks.output: Runner resource-lifecycle-only implementation, direct owner reporting, owner-derived read paths, and removal migration for RunnerWorks.
tasks.notes: The behavioral cutover is forward-only once new owner-led work is accepted; retain schema rollback only before cutover.
